coact: CoactDetect runs at detect_folder.detector_params('coact', ...) on every lab stream: the project's calibrated point, as bugarach detect runs it, and the same settings on all three so the removal arm is comparable across them.

checks.removal_null_choice_note: mask_matched divides by the circular shift of the full trains with the recording's own episodes then cut out; mismatched divides by the circular shift of the already-removed trains, which scatters each ROI's holes to its own phase
checks.leave_heaviest_out_note: var_ratio drops the five recordings with the largest 1-minute variance under the arm's own null, which is the weight the count-variance figure gives them; excess drops the five with the most expected onset pairs, which is the weight the correlograms give them
